page_note: No cosmological substrate present. Page is dominated by Manichaean ecclesial discourse: a first-person testimonial/confession about fasting practice (ⲛⲏⲥⲧⲓⲁ), Sundays (ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁⲕⲏ), counting angels begotten in the fasts of the elect (ⲛⲉⲕⲗⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ), and a petition concerning a church (ⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ) and presbyters (ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ). Closes with the standard apostolic dialogue frame ("Then, when the Apostle heard..."). The arithmetic of fast-begotten angels (50 men × 3 Sundays × 7 angels = 1050) is institutional numerology, not cosmic mapping. Heavy physical damage (100% damage ratio) but the surviving vocabulary is unambiguously ecclesial/institutional throughout.
